verdict.rationale: The pack only shows that PostHog can be self-hosted via a free MIT-licensed Docker Compose deployment, which lets a user control where data lives by running it themselves, but there is no explicit documentation of a managed EU/US (or other) cloud region-selection feature for data residency. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection UI or docs (e.g., choosing EU vs US cloud), compliance certifications, and any independent confirmation of residency guarantees.
